card.name: Mark inside "postmarketing" and similar
card.fires_on: The piece "mark" or "-mark" right after "Post" in "postmarketing", mostly in adverse-reaction sections. It also fires on "House" in a publisher name and on "mark" in "birthmark".

modes.label: Postmarketing split
modes.description: The "mark" piece that follows "Post" in "postmarketing" reports or cases.

modes.label: Other word endings
modes.description: A closing piece of a compound or name, such as a publisher's "House" or the "mark" in birthmark.
